sentences.text: Group CEO Georges Elhedery said at the 2025 annual results that HSBC is targeting a return on tangible equity of 17% or better in each year from 2026 to 2028, plus year-on-year revenue growth rising to 5% in 2028, and at the August 2026 interim stage described a bank "becoming the stronger bank we set out to build", executing with discipline.

Senior ranks have turned over: Ida Liu became CEO of HSBC Private Bank in January 2026, succeeding interim CEO Gabriel Castello; Cecile Ratcliffe became CEO of HSBC Continental Europe from 1 June 2026; David Rice was named first Chief AI Officer from 1 April 2026.

sentences.text: Reuters reported insurance chief Edward Moncreiffe is leaving, one of several exits during Elhedery's overhaul.

sentences.quote: In October 2024, it announced a global restructuring from what it calls a complex matrix governance structure of three business lines and five geographical regions to four new units: corporate and institutional banking, international wealth and premier banking, Hong Kong and the UK.
sentences.text: Under Georges Elhedery, who replaced Noel Quinn as chief executive in September 2024, HSBC was reorganised from a complex matrix of three business lines and five regions into four units: corporate and institutional banking, international wealth and premier banking, Hong Kong and the UK, targeting $1.5bn of annualised cost reduction by end-2026 against $1.8bn of upfront costs.

For 2025 it reported pre-tax profit of $29.9bn, RoTE of 13.3% (17.2% excluding notable items), a 14.9% CET1 ratio, a $0.75 total dividend and $6bn of completed buybacks, with total returns of $18.9bn.

sentences.quote: Following an impact on capital owing to the privatisation of Hang Seng Bank, we expect to restore our CET1 capital ratio within our target range through a combination of organic capital generation and not initiating any further buybacks
sentences.text: Following the capital impact of the Hang Seng Bank privatisation, the board paused further buybacks until CET1 is restored to its target range.

sentences.text: HSBC Holdings PLC targets a return on tangible equity of 17 percent or better for 2026, 2027 and 2028, excluding notable items, and delivered 19.1 percent for the first half of 2026 with a CET1 ratio of 14.1 percent.

A 2024 reorganisation into four businesses, Hong Kong, UK, Corporate and Institutional Banking, and International Wealth and Premier Banking, is intended to speed up strategic delivery, with total simplification savings revised up to 2 billion dollars after 1.7 billion of actioned saves.
Wealth is a core growth engine: balances were 1.6 trillion dollars at March 2026 with 39 billion of net new money in the first quarter, 34 billion booked in Asia.
